dce_browser.note: DCE official JSON endpoints require a real headed Chrome session so the site JavaScript can attach the dynamic Riversafe token to in-page fetch calls. In headless/server environments use Xvfb or set QUOTE_DCE_CHROME_PATH to a real Chrome binary.

exchange_official.note: Preferred first-hand route for domestic futures daily contract bars. Main-continuous series are constructed locally by open-interest priority; AkShare remains fallback for unsupported, empty, or failed official requests.

official_product_spec_enrichment.note: Exchange-specific product specification enrichment feeds normalized root-product evidence into the common discovery adapter. DCE uses the official browser-assisted contractInfo endpoint, auto-discovers listed-product page URLs from the DCE homepage, and can parse official listed-product pages for product name, code, quote unit, trading unit, and tick size; category remains governed metadata where the official page does not expose internal taxonomy. GFEX auto-discovers listed-product page URLs from the GFEX listed-products entry page, parses official listed-product pages for the same normalized fields, and merges governed category metadata. SHFE uses official product pages behind Safeline/meta-refresh, discovers product leaf URLs shaped as /products/futures/.../<symbol>_f/, parses the pageList contract object for product name, code, quote unit, trading unit, and tick size, and merges governed category metadata. INE uses the same official page family with browser fallback for challenge handling. CZCE first attempts browser-assisted listed-product page discovery after static WAF/challenge responses, preserves official product entry URL/title/context evidence, and uses official FutureDataReferenceData.xml for product name, code, currency, quote unit, trading unit, and tick size.

official_calendar_backfill.note: Historical exchange calendars are verified from official daily market-data endpoints. Future dates are not weekday-filled unless an official notice source explicitly verifies them.

market_data_sync.note: Long-running futures market-data sync/backfill emits stage progress logs and refreshes ingestion_runs.updated_at/metadata.progress at this cadence.

secrets.note: Do not store API keys in tracked config files. Put values in environment variables or a gitignored local runtime config.
